fixture_sources.protocol-fault: def choose_move(turn, my_history, opponent_history, rng); 'X'; end
fixture_sources.slow-response: def choose_move(turn, my_history, opponent_history, rng); sleep 0.2; 'R'; end
fixture_sources.memory: def choose_move(turn, my_history, opponent_history, rng); value = 'x' * (1024 * 1024 * 1024); value.object_id; 'R'; end

practice_artifacts.fixed-move: def choose_move(turn, my_history, opponent_history, rng); 'R'; end
practice_artifacts.copycat: def choose_move(turn, my_history, opponent_history, rng); opponent_history.empty? ? 'R' : opponent_history[-1]; end
practice_artifacts.protocol-test: def choose_move(turn, my_history, opponent_history, rng); return 'X' unless turn == my_history.length && my_history.length == opponent_history.length && (my_history + opponent_history).match?(/\A[RPS]*\z/); ['R','P','S'][turn % 3]; end
practice_artifacts.random: def choose_move(turn, my_history, opponent_history, rng); ['R','P','S'][rng.next_int(3)]; end
